authority: A5 SYNTHESIS RULING 3 (grid/counts/endpoints/pilot/sidedness = A1b Q1, quality gates swapped to Gemini + mechanical; NO DINOv2 anywhere in data selection)
deterministic: pure function of (CONTENT_POOL_union.json, split_v1.2, davis.yaml, seed 42)

tau_endpoint.basis: p95 over ALL prefix-conditioned inline-validation clips (all checkpoints)
tau_endpoint.definition: pixel-space rel-L2 between the generated clip's frames 0..8 and the 9-frame prefix conditioning mp4; RGB uint8 -> float [0,1]; rel_l2 = ||gen-cond|| / ||cond||
tau_endpoint.space: pixel (NOT latent, NOT DINOv2 -- Ruling 3(i) bans harness substrate in selection)

mechanical_rejects.authority: A5 Ruling 3(ii) -- per-clip HARD rejects, mechanical ONLY
mechanical_rejects.decode_corruption: ffmpeg decode fails, or frame count != 121, or geometry != 480x640
mechanical_rejects.frozen_or_black: mean abs inter-frame delta over frames 9..120 < 1.0/255 (frozen), or mean luma < 8/255 on >= 10% of frames (black)
mechanical_rejects.endpoint_identity: prefix rel-L2(gen[0:9], anchor) > tau = 0.1279 -- same pixel-space measurement as the tau calibration
mechanical_rejects.NOT_USED: DINOv2 / any harness substrate -- banned from selection by Ruling 3(i)

batch_gate.note: only FLASH models work -- every *-pro-* returns HTTP 429 (DOSSIER 5.1); thinking models return empty text at low output caps, hence >= 2000

control_arm.what: real corpus clips of the same 11 classes, same judge, same prompt
control_arm.why: instrument validation -- a failing control invalidates the batch score

pre_registered_fallback: A5 Ruling 3: if the 33-clip pilot fails its gates, S1 DROPS entirely and the mix renormalizes to S0 15 / S2 85. The schedule does not slip.

verdict_rule.PASS: batch top-1 >= 80% AND control arm top-1 >= 80% AND mechanical reject rate <= 10% (<= 3 of 33)
verdict_rule.FAIL_S1_DROPS: batch top-1 < 80% with a passing control arm
verdict_rule.INSTRUMENT_INVALID: control arm top-1 < 80% -- the judge cannot read these classes off real footage either; re-adjudicate, do not blame S1

prompts.grammar: one-sided: '{A-role description}. sksz.'   |   two-sided: '{A-role description}. sksz. {B-role description}.'  -- the corpus grammar of prompts.render_prompt(), Ruling 5
